json.name: Tear Consistency Fix
json.author: Unknown
json.description:
[h1]Features[/h1]
Imagine a situation: You play as Jacob & Esau, you pick up Torn Photo as Esau and... Tears on his character model switch from red to blue??? While he still shoots with red tears??? Like what, why?
I created this mod specifically to fix that.

Situations when my fix works:
[list]
[*]When you play as Lazarus Risen (after losing a life as regular Lazarus)
[*]When you play as Lilith (She can't shoot, but she clearly should have bloody costumes)
[*]When you play as Esau
[*]When you play as Tainted Eve (tears become black like her mascara, yes!)
[*]When you play as Tainted Lazarus (second form)
[*]When you play as Tainted Lilith (well, same as regular one)
[*]When you play as Tainted Bethany
[*]When you have Stigmata, Pop or Haemolacria (those items turn your tears red, so it makes sense)
[*]When you have Eve's Mascara (again, it makes your tears black, all makes sense)
[/list]

[h1]Future plans[/h1]
[list]
[*]I'd like to give poopy tears to Tainted ???, but it's a pinch more complicated. I kinda got tired.
[*]Epiphany support.
[/list]

[h1]Compatibility[/h1]
[list]
[*]Mod works both on Repentance and Repentance+
[*]Mod works both with and without Repentogon
[*]There may be some issues with mods that change costumes or hair, but it's nothing critical. If you want to fix some hair mod not working, just go to "mods\consistent tear costumes_3797506645\resources\gfx\characters\costumes" and delete the whole folder. After that, this mod won't override character models anymore.
[/list]

[h1]Why did you make this mod?[/h1]
It was prep work for my Jacob & Esau reskin. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3799115329]Have you seen it?[/url]
